name: YuE2 Music
tagline: AI music creation with a score-first workflow
description: YuE2 Music is an AI music studio that lets you inspect and edit a symbolic score before synthesizing audio. Exports include ABC, MIDI note tracks, MusicXML and FLAC. Pricing is freemium: 20 signup credits, valid 7 days; paid credit packs and optional subscriptions. There are no separated audio stems.
